summary: Milestone 2026.05.123 operational retrospective complete. Analyzed 364 min wall time / 70 experiments (avg 5 min). Slowest paths: Exp 1603 (88 min), Exp 1591 (48 min), Exp 1606 (15 min), Exp 1609 (14 min), and Full-Scale Pipeline v3 gate (14 min). Both RTX 3090s were completely idle at 4 MB / 0% utilization. Estimated 40% savings recoverable via DualGPURunner parallelization.
slowest_experiments: Exp 1603: Energy-Based Constraint Network (EBCN) coherence sco (88 min)
Exp 1591: Upgrade DCCD smoke to reusable structured verdict ad (48 min)
Exp 1606: DCCD repair on multi-hop reasoning tasks (15 min)
Full-Scale Pipeline v3 - Gated on Exp 1414 Repair Executor (14 min)
bottlenecks_identified: Exp 1603 and Exp 1591 consumed disproportionate wall time serially
Full-Scale Pipeline v3 repeated gating delays
improvements_suggested: Deploy DualGPURunner to execute tasks in parallel on GPU 0 and GPU 1
Optimize Exp 1603 constraint network coherence calculation
Cache or optimize Full-Scale Pipeline v3 gates to prevent repeated delays
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Wire DualGPURunner to utilize idle RTX 3090s
Profile Exp 1603 to address the 88-minute bottleneck
Retire or cache identical gates for Full-Scale Pipeline v3
meta_reflection: Continuous underutilization of DualGPU infrastructure persists. Addressing this and profiling the longest-running experiments will yield the greatest efficiency gains.
